questions.stem: A 72-year-old man without a prior history presents with a recent history of cognitive deficits. The patient has had a stable level of consciousness and denies any current or past substance abuse.The medical chart reveals a history of megaloblastic anemia and a subtotal gastrectomy for severe peptic ulcer disease. Which of the following initial interventions is most appropriate?

options.label: A
options.text: Order a reversible workup for dementia

options.label: C
options.text: Obtain a forensic examination to evaluate competency.
